key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11B94
name: invoke_library_pointer_from_base
description: Loads a function pointer from a table reached through a base register and calls it, then returns without other work. It is a single-call trampoline into the library vector table.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11B9C
name: forward_call_to_library_slot
description: Calls a function pointer read from a fixed offset of a base-register table and returns. It takes no arguments and does nothing beyond that call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11BAE
name: jump_through_library_vector_slot
description: Calls the function whose pointer sits at a fixed offset of a table addressed through a register, then returns. No arguments are passed and no value is kept.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11BC0
name: call_library_function_pointer
description: Reads a function pointer from a table at a fixed offset from the base register and calls it, then returns. The routine has no arguments and returns nothing.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11BE0
name: invoke_library_entry_from_base
description: Follows a pointer held at one offset of the base register and calls the function at another offset of that table. It returns immediately afterwards.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11BF0
name: call_library_base_function
description: Calls one function pointer read from a fixed offset of the library base register and returns. Nothing else is done in the body.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11C0A
name: call_entry_from_offset_table
description: Reads a function pointer from a table reached through a base register and calls it at a fixed offset. The routine returns afterwards with no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11C18
name: call_second_offset_table_entry
description: Calls a function from an offset table at a fixed negative offset and returns. The call is the only action in the body.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11C24
name: call_third_offset_table_entry
description: Calls another function from the same offset table and returns. Nothing else happens in the body.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11C3C
name: call_nested_table_pointer_entry
description: Dereferences a pointer stored in a table at one offset, then calls the function at a second offset of that target. It returns afterwards.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11C48
name: call_chained_table_function
description: Dereferences a pointer chain from the base register and calls the function found at a fixed offset inside it. The body performs no other work.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11C5E
name: call_offset_chained_table_entry
description: Follows a pointer chain from a table and calls the function at a fixed offset, then returns. The routine only forwards the call.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11CB6
name: call_data_chained_table_entry
description: Follows a pointer chain from the base register and calls the entry at a fixed offset, then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11CC2
name: call_deep_chained_table_entry
description: Follows a pointer chain from the base register and calls the function at a short fixed offset, then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11CCE
name: call_indirect_chained_entry
description: Follows a pointer chain from the base register and calls the function found at a fixed offset, then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11CF6
name: call_final_chained_table_entry
description: Follows a pointer chain from the base register and calls the function at a fixed offset within it. The body performs nothing else.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:BattleChess:0:11D12
name: call_library_slot_from_base
description: Calls a function pointer taken from a fixed offset of the library base register and returns. The body has no other action.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:LoadWB:0:0000
name: start_from_cli_or_workbench
description: Program entry point that checks whether it was started from the command line or from Workbench. From the command line it splits the argument text on spaces into a list and calls the main routine with it; from Workbench it runs a setup routine, closes the library and returns the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:LoadWB:0:013C
name: close_library_then_reply
description: Closes a library handle and, if a stored flag is set, forbids multitasking and replies to a message. It returns the value it was given by its caller.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:LoadWB:0:0190
name: call_two_library_functions
description: Calls two library functions one after the other through the base register, passing no arguments. It returns no value.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:LoadWB:0:01A2
name: open_dos_library_with_fallback
description: Opens the dos library by name and returns the handle when that succeeds. On failure it runs a setup call, closes the library and returns the error code 100.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:LoadWB:2:0000
name: start_workbench_task_process
description: Starts the workbench task as a new process when it is not already running, reporting an error if it cannot be started. It parses a debug option from the command line, looks up a resident tag, creates the process and then exchanges messages on its port.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:LoadWB:2:0110
name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two null-terminated strings byte by byte and returns minus one, one, or zero for less, greater, or equal respectively.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:LoadWB:2:0138
name: build_linked_lock_list
description: Walks a zero-terminated list of entries, allocating an eight-byte node for each, duplicating a lock for its value, and linking the nodes together. It returns the first node, or whatever was built so far if an allocation or lock fails.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:LoadWB:5:0000
name: forward_global_with_stack_slot
description: Calls another routine and passes it a global value, the caller's parameter, and the address of an eight-byte stack slot. It returns nothing itself.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:LoadWB:4:0000
name: format_message_into_stack_buffer
description: Formats text through the library's raw formatting call into a 140-byte stack buffer, measures the result, and passes the buffer and its length on when the length is non-zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:LoadWB:4:004C
name: store_byte_at_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the data register to the memory address held in an address register, then returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:bootblock:0:000C
name: boot_entry_copy_or_dispatch
description: Boot block entry point. It bumps a nesting counter, then either copies a block of boot code into a buffer and jumps into it when a flag word matches, or calls a library function and decrements the counter, returning minus one or zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:bootblock:0:0048
name: boot_dispatch_with_interrupt_mask
description: Same body as the boot entry routine: it bumps a nesting counter, copies a block and jumps into it when a flag word matches, or calls a library function and decrements the counter. The interrupt-register access recorded in its facts does not appear in the shown code.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:bootblock:0:00A0
name: init_counter_and_test_call
description: Clears a shared counter, calls two other routines, then makes a library call. It returns minus one if that call yields zero, and otherwise decrements the nesting counter and returns zero.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:bootblock:0:00EA
name: install_disk_device_handler
description: Obtains a structure pointer from a library call and, when it is non-zero, installs a handler routine in two places while saving the previous values in data slots. If the lookup fails it makes another library call and returns minus one or zero; the trackdisk device name is referenced.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:bootblock:0:015C
name: build_self_linked_node
description: Builds a small node in the data area with a marker word and pointer fields that refer back to its own location, then calls a library function with it and stores the result.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:bootblock:0:01B8
name: handle_disk_checksum_interrupt
description: Interrupt handler that checks a controller status bit pattern and a state word; when they match it copies a block, sums its longs with carry into a checksum word, updates two counters, and then chains to the previously saved handler.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:bootblock:0:02CA
name: chain_to_handler_after_timeout
description: Advances a timeout counter while two state words hold the unset value, and calls a routine once the counter passes its threshold. It then calls the previously saved handler.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:bootblock:0:0300
name: keyboard_handshake_and_sync
description: Handshakes with the keyboard serial register: it waits until a ready flag is set, runs a fixed delay, then compares each received byte with an inverted and rotated expected value until an end marker arrives, and finally sets a DMA control word.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:bootblock:0:036A
name: enable_dma_and_release_counter
description: Writes a DMA enable word to the custom chip control register alias, decrements the nesting counter and returns.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:bootblock:0:0388
name: advance_cyclic_state_counter
description: Cycles a shared state counter through the values minus one, zero, one and two, wrapping back to minus one after two, then calls another routine.

key: battle chess (1988)(interplay)[cr qtx][v byte bandit]/Battle Chess (1988)(Interplay)[cr QTX][v Byte Bandit].adf:bootblock:0:03A4
name: store_minus_one_then_call
description: Writes the word value minus one through the address register and then calls another routine.
